title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.32
summary: Fixes stale Update Center progress after the updater service restarts during an update.
changes: Recover stale running update states after updater/container restarts
Mark interrupted build/install jobs explicitly instead of leaving progress stuck at 42%
Keep backup information available for manual rollback after an interrupted update

Preserve all v2.20.31 recording timeline and continuous playback behavior
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.32
description: Recovers interrupted updater transactions on service startup instead of leaving the Update Center stuck at an intermediate progress value such as 42%.
releaseNotes: Version 2.20.32 fixes interrupted updater recovery and preserves the v2.20.31 recording playback changes.
